cells.error.addCells: {here}.cells must be the list of cells (texts) of the one row to add
cells.error.beforeAndAfter: before and after of {here} cannot be written together (only one of them)
cells.error.headingRepeated: "{name}" in {here} matches {count} column headings (tell the headings apart before naming it)
cells.error.manyRowsFit: {count} rows match {here} (add columns to narrow it to one row, or point by number and old): {rows}
cells.error.needsValue: {here}.value needs the text to write, or edit, append or prepend
cells.error.noChange: {at} has no way to change it (one of set, add, remove)
cells.error.noRowNumber: {here} has no row {n} (the table has {count} rows. Numbers start from 0)
cells.error.noSuchHeading: "{name}" in {here} is not a column heading (columns: {columns})
cells.error.oldCellDiffers: {here}.old differs from the current cell (now: {now}). Read it again, then write
cells.error.oldNeeded: {here} points to a row by number, so add its current content in old ({held}). Pointing by column values ({"<column heading>": "<value>"}) needs no old
cells.error.oldRowDiffers: {here}.old differs from the current row (now: {now}). Read it again, then write
cells.error.oldWithoutBeforeAfter: {here}.old is for when before or after is given as a number
cells.error.rowNeeded: Name the row in {here} by a number from 0 or by column values ({"<column heading>": "<value>"})
cells.error.rowNumber: The row number in {here} must be a number from 0
cells.error.strayKey: {stray} cannot be written in {at} (write the whole array, or change part of it with set, add, remove)
cells.error.valueNotText: {here}.value must be a text, or an object with edit, append or prepend
cells.error.valueNotTextAt: The value of "{heading}" in {here} must be a text
cells.error.writtenAndRemoved: {here} is a row that {set} writes (either remove it or write it)
cells.held.row: the list of cells of that row
